unmapped: Disjoint linear contextual bandit: each of K arms has its own unknown parameter beta_i in R^d; reward X_t^T beta_i + sigma-sub-Gaussian noise
Learner must choose a subset of context features (survey questions) to observe before acting; only queried coordinates of X_t are observed; secondary goal of minimizing survey length
Beta-min assumption: each nonzero coordinate of each beta_i exceeds a known threshold beta_min in absolute value; the learner knows beta_min
Contexts arbitrary (no distributional assumption); ||X_t||_1 <= L and ||beta_i||_1 <= b, rewards Y_i(t) in [0,1]
settings.definition_quote: At time $t$, pulling arm $i$ would yield a reward $Y_i(t):=X_t^{\transpose}\beta_i +\epsilon_{i,t}$. Where $\epsilon_{i,t}$ are independent sequence of $\sigma$-sub-Gaussian random variables. ... Note that we do not observe $X_t$ and only observe $(X_t)_{\pi^s_t}$

conditions: Assumption 2: ||X_t||_1 <= L, ||beta_i||_1 <= b, rewards Y_i(t) in [0,1]
tuning: theta_{k,t} chosen as in eq. (ridge-conftbound) with confidence delta

source.label: thm:ridge-survey-ucb-regret
source.quote: Suppose \cref{ass:beta-min} and \cref{ass:bounded-rewards} hold. Let $\delta,\alpha > 0$ be fixed constants. Let $\conftBound{k}{t}$ be chosen as in \cref{eq:ridge-conftbound} for all $k,t$. Then with probability at least $1-\delta$, Ridge $\SurveyUCB$ has the following regret guarantee: R_T \leq O(d \sqrt{KT\log(K)} \log(T)).

results.notes: Regret r_t defined via expected rewards (means), bound holds w.p. 1-delta. Dependence on delta, sigma, L, b hidden in O. Confidence widths do not use T, so treated as anytime.

conditions: Assumption 2: ||X_t||_1 <= L, ||beta_i||_1 <= b, rewards Y_i(t) in [0,1]
tuning: lambda_{k,t} = 4 sigma L sqrt(2/n_{k,t} log(4dK n_{k,t}^2/delta))
theta_{k,t} as in the paper's confidence bound equation

source.label: thm:elastic-net-survey-ucb-regret
source.quote: Suppose \cref{ass:beta-min} and \cref{ass:bounded-rewards} hold. Let $\delta,\alpha > 0$ be fixed constants. For all $k,t$, let $\lambda_{k,t}$ and  $\conftBound{k}{t}$ be chosen as in \cref{eq:elnet-L1reg} and \cref{eq:ridge-conftbound} respectively. Then with probability at least $1-\delta$, Elastic Net $\SurveyUCB$ has the following regret guarantee: R_T \leq O(K^{1/4} d^{1/2} T^{3/4}  \log^{3/4}(T) \log^{1/4}(dK) ).

results.notes: Theorem text references eq:ridge-conftbound for theta but proof uses eq:elnet-conftbound; likely typo. Treated as anytime since tuning does not use T.
